第一百三十五章 化解血咒（第1页）
化解血咒（化解血咒（第22页）他双手抱头，一点点的弯下腰，肩头不停的颤抖，极致的悔恨与悲痛，将其陷入无尽的自我折磨之中。秦枫见状心中不忍，缓步上前，右手轻轻搭在雪林君的左肩上，语气温和的宽慰道：“师兄，此事怪不得你。世间劫难皆有定数，天命如此，非你一人之过，不必独自扛下所有罪责。”另一边，化解了死咒的雪沐云，伫立半空，默默的看着下方死气沉沉的雪家堡。往日的繁华盛景早已荡然无存，一张张熟悉的面孔尽数消失。明明希望就在眼前，家族终究还是错失机会，再无挽回余地。她再也压制不住内心的悲痛，胸中气血翻涌逆行，喉头一甜，猛地喷出一口鲜血，身子一软昏厥过去，失去掌控的身躯朝着地面急速坠落。秦枫急忙一挥衣袖，一道柔和的灵力，稳稳托住雪沐云下坠的身躯，将其带到秦枫身侧。他没有再出言安慰，而是静静立在一旁，任由雪林君尽情宣泄积压在心中的情绪。不知等了多久，雪林君的情绪才渐渐平复下来。又过了一会儿，他才郑重地朝着秦枫深深躬身一礼，言辞恳切的说道：“多谢主人出手相助，对于沐云而言，实仍再造之恩。”秦枫洒脱的开口道：“师兄，前尘往事已然不能改变，就让它随风散去吧。”雪林君重重点头，将这份恩情记在心底，随即化作一道流光，径直遁入金丝蛛的眉心之中。那原本体形近十丈的金丝蛛，周身金光流转，身躯再度急速缩小，顷刻间，便化作一颗小巧的金色圆球，悬浮在秦枫身前。秦枫抬手将金色小球收入储物戒，再以灵力托住依旧昏迷不醒的雪沐云，身形一动，朝着远处的仙坛飞去。当秦枫到达仙坛上空，低头俯视，整个仙坛被防御大阵的结界笼罩，细密的阵纹在结界上游走。仙坛正处于高度戒备的状态，隔绝了内外的一切联系。镇守阵枢的修士确认来人是秦枫，即刻催动阵法开启结界通道。秦枫穿行而入，落至仙坛演武场上。秦洛天、冯有德与众位仙坛筑基期长老，见秦枫到来，当即上前行礼：“见过二公子。”秦浩一眼看见陷入昏迷的雪沐云，心头一紧，顾不得礼数，快步上前将她搂入怀中，急切的问道：“沐云这是怎么了？”秦枫解释道：“她接连遭遇变故，因伤心过度，而伤及心神，并无性命之忧，只需静心休养一段时日，便能慢慢恢复。”即便知道并无大碍，秦浩依旧心急如焚，一把抱起雪沐云，朝着秦家宅院飞掠而去。秦洛天正要上前阻拦，却被秦枫抬手止住：“由他去吧。”随即开口问道：“薛坛主与几位长老如今伤势如何？”众人相视一眼，秦洛天开口道：“老祖正在为坛主等人疗伤，尚未离开静室。”秦枫暗自思索：有老祖亲自出手疗伤，这么长时间过去，还没有好转，看来众人伤势不容乐观。

Chapter 135: Resolving the Blood Curse (Page 1)
Dissolving the Blood Curse (Dissolving the Blood Curse (Page 22)) He held his head with both hands and bent down a little. His shoulders kept shaking, and the extreme regret and grief plunged him into endless self-torture. Seeing this, Qin Feng couldn't bear it. He walked forward slowly, put his right hand gently on Jun Xue Lin's left shoulder, and comforted him in a gentle tone: "Brother, you are not to blame for this. All disasters in the world are destined, and it is not your fault alone. You don't have to bear all the blame alone." On the other side, Xue Muyun, who had resolved the death curse, stood in mid-air, silently looking at the lifeless Xue Family Castle below. The prosperity of the past was gone, and all the familiar faces disappeared. Although hope was right in front of them, the family still missed the opportunity after all, and there was no room for recovery. She could no longer suppress the grief in her heart, and the blood surged in her chest, and her throat suddenly became sweet. He spat out a mouthful of blood and fainted, losing control of his body as he quickly fell to the ground. Qin Feng hurriedly waved his sleeves and held Xue Muyun's falling body firmly, bringing him to Qin Feng's side. He did not say any more words of comfort, but stood aside quietly, letting Mr. Xue Lin vent the emotions he had accumulated in his heart. After waiting for an unknown amount of time, Mr. Xue Lin's emotions gradually calmed down. After a while, he solemnly bowed deeply to Qin Feng and said sincerely: "Thank you, master, for your help. For Mu Yun, it is still a blessing." Qin Feng said freely and freely: "Brother, the past cannot be changed, just let it go with the wind." Lord Xue Lin nodded heavily, remembering this kindness in his heart, and then turned into a stream of light, which went straight into the golden silk spider's eyebrows. The golden silk spider, which was originally nearly ten feet in size, shrank rapidly again with golden light flowing around it. In an instant, it turned into a small golden ball, floating in front of Qin Feng. Qin Feng raised his hand to put the golden ball into the storage ring, then used his spiritual power to hold Xue Muyun, who was still unconscious, and flew towards the distant fairy altar. When Qin Feng reached the fairy altar and looked down, the entire fairy altar was enveloped by a defensive formation. , fine formations wandered over the barrier. The Immortal Altar was on high alert, cutting off all contact with the inside and outside. The monks guarding the formation hub confirmed that the person coming was Qin Feng, and immediately activated the formation to open the barrier passage. Qin Feng walked through and landed on the Immortal Altar's martial arts field. When Qin Feng arrived, Qin Luotian, Feng Youde, and other elders in the Immortal Altar's foundation stage immediately stepped forward and saluted: "I saw the second young master falling into a coma." Xue Muyun's heart tightened, and without regard for etiquette, he quickly stepped forward and hugged her into his arms, asking urgently: "What's wrong with Mu Yun?" Qin Feng explained: "She encountered accidents one after another. She was too sad and hurt her mind. She is not worried about her life. She only needs to rest quietly for a period of time before she can recover slowly." Even though he knew that there was nothing serious, Qin Hao was still anxious, picked up Xue Muyun and flew towards the Qin family's house. And go. Qin Luotian was about to step forward to stop him, but Qin Feng raised his hand to stop him: "Let him go." Then he asked: "How are the injuries of Altar Master Xue and the elders now?" Everyone looked at each other, and Qin Luotian said: "The ancestor is healing the injuries of the Altar Master and others, and has not left the quiet room." Qin Feng thought to himself: The ancestor healed the injury personally, and it has not improved after such a long time. It seems that everyone's injuries are not optimistic.
